title: Review: Catching up
tip:
This review mixes the whole unit.

- **করতাম · করতি · করতে · করত · করতেন**: used to (habit, long state)
- **করছিলাম · করছিলে · করছিল · করছিলেন**: was doing (in progress)
- **করলাম**, **এল**, **চলে গেল**: did (one event)

Time words help: **প্রতি**, **প্রায়ই**, **ছোটবেলায়**, **গরমকালে** point to the habitual; **ঠিক তখন** introduces an event; **তখন** with -ছিল- sets the scene.

Negatives: **খেতাম না**, **ঘুমাচ্ছিলাম না**, and **এখন আর … না** for 'not any more'.

exercises.title: Nadia: my Fridays

lines.bn: ছোটবেলায় প্রতি শুক্রবার আমি বাবার সাথে বাজারে যেতাম।
lines.tr: chhotobelay proti shukrobar ami babar shathe bajare jetam.
lines.en: As a child I went to the market with my father every Friday.

lines.bn: দুপুরে আমরা সবাই একসাথে ভাত খেতাম।
lines.tr: dupure amra shobai ekshathe bhat khetam.
lines.en: At noon we all ate together.

lines.bn: বিকালে আমরা মাঠে ক্রিকেট খেলতাম, আর আমার ভাই আমাদের সাথে আসত।
lines.tr: bikale amra mathe kriket kheltam, ar amar bhai amader shathe ashto.
lines.en: In the afternoon we played cricket in the field, and my brother used to come with us.

lines.en: We lived in Dhaka, but in the holidays we went to the village.

audio.en: The phone was ringing, but we were chatting.

options: The phone rang, so we stopped chatting.

audio.bn: গ্রাম অনেক বদলে গেছে, এখন আর আগের মতো নেই।
audio.tr: gram onek bodle gechhe, ekhon ar ager moto nei.
audio.en: The village has changed a lot; it isn't what it used to be.

options: The village hasn't changed at all.
We moved to a new village last year.
The village has changed a lot; it isn't what it used to be.
The village is changing, but slowly.
